summary: Constructing Date from a proven ECMAScript Date Time String Format string uses Date.parse semantics then TimeClip.

target.notes: Implement the normative Date Time String Format. An absent offset is UTC for date-only forms and local time for date-time forms.

semantics.result: fresh Date with parsed or NaN time value

caveats: Do not use DateTime.Parse: accepted grammar and absent-offset semantics differ.

tests.name: date-only is UTC
tests.expected_behavior: prints 0 in every host time zone

tests.name: invalid standard field becomes invalid Date
